decisions.reason: As a handle family that remained listed through 2024, it likely has modest but still unresolved value and low carrying cost within the firm's broad architectural range, so the option is worth keeping.
Its own product page in 2024 suggests stronger commitment and better prospects, and its multifunctional positioning fits the firm's barrier-free and system-solution strategy.

This looks like a standard portfolio extension with less visible traction than the standout products, but for a German architectural hardware maker the cost of keeping such a compatible design option is likely still lower than abandoning it now.
Award recognition, a dedicated page in both years, and clear fit with the firm's design-led door-and-window systems make this the strongest candidate to retain and continue supporting.
